name: Ponga (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, red and white, charged at the centre with the seal of the concejo of Ponga (a knight on horseback within an inscribed ring).
history: Municipal flag of Ponga; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: seal with a knight on horseback within an inscribed ring
